text:
maria_ae: New POC request from MerchantPay. They require private deployment, no public ingress, strict egress allowlist, and their IDS needs original client IPs. Quick: PrivateLink vs peering, NAT/EIP options, ports to open, and a back-of-envelope cost difference vs Dedicated?

tom_se: short checklist for presales call: account topology, steady RPS, burst RPS, compliance tags.

maria_ae: single aws acct for now. Steady ~40rps, bursts to ~300. PCI in-scope. They'll only allow a handful of EIPs outbound.

vikram_arch: summary: PrivateLink (NLB + VPCE) if you want minimal network changes and easier security signoff. Peering/TGW if they want full L3 access or to host our nodes in their subnets.

vikram_arch: quick bullets:
- PrivateLink: pros = no route table edits, per-service endpoint, simpler audit. cons = per-region VPCEs, no transitive routing.
- TGW/Peering: pros = low hop, flexible. cons = CIDR coordination, larger review cycle.

olivia_netops: source IP preservation patterns:
1) Customer-managed egress proxy with static EIP (recommended). We call proxy via PrivateLink or peering; proxy forwards and preserves headers.
2) Place NAT in customer account and run agents there; NAT will SNAT so original IP lost unless they route back.
3) Advanced: BGP/VPN with return-path config (complex).

maria_ae: firewall snippet to paste?

vikram_arch: yes, pasteable block:

```
# MerchantPay firewall egress snippet for Redwood POC
- Protocol: TCP
- Ports: 443
- Destination: <VPCE CIDR> OR <Redwood EIP set>
- Description: Redwood private endpoints
# Optional: allow TCP 8000 from Redwood ops IPs for healthchecks (confirm exact list)
```

olivia_netops: TLS inspection note: ask if they do TLS intercept. If yes, advise SNI allowlist for our hostnames or opt for TLS passthrough. Also confirm mutual TLS requirements for any control-plane calls.

tom_se: ballpark pricing for scoping (not a quote):
- Dedicated: predictable monthly commit (example: one 8-GPU reserved pool ~$18k/month depending on model and batching).
- Private: platform fee + customer infra. Typical onboarding ~$25k, annual support ~$10k+, infra costs billed in customer account.

maria_ae: blockers to call out: overlapping CIDRs (if peering), strict no-external-ip policies, and any requirement for an isolated control plane.

vikram_arch: ops note: if they refuse any external EIPs, PrivateLink + an in-VPC proxy with EIPs on their side is the usual compromise.

calendar-bot: reminder: create tech-handoff invite and attach security questionnaire.

maria_ae: scheduling 30m handoff with MerchantPay + netops tomorrow 2pm PT. @vikram_arch @olivia_netops can you join? I'll ask them to provide their proposed outbound EIP list pre-call.

vikram_arch: I can join.

olivia_netops: available.

maria_ae: thanks team, I'll update thread after call. :thumbsup:
